PLAN.md's original corpus measurement counted only event_type failures, so this gap was undocumented until this WU's full corpus run. Fixing it requires editing specfuse/loop/data/schemas/event.schema.json — the vendored envelope this WU is explicitly forbidden to touch (criterion 5, Do-not-touch list) — which is a cross-repo/vendored-schema design decision, not this WU's call, matching the escalation trigger verbatim.
